children: New Delhi, Sept. 17 -- Indian stock market is all about finding that hidden gem with strong fundamentals, stable business, and robust potential opportunities. History is filled with stocks that have delivered that have doubled and even tripled investors' wealth in just a few years. One such multibagger stock is Cupid Limited, which has delivered a whopping 569% return in one year and around 6,775% return in three years.
The company's share price was even lower than Rs.10 three years ago. Fast forward to September 17, 2026, the same stock has surged to Rs.279.15 closing Thursday's trading session at this level.

To put the stupendous Cupid share price rally into perspective, let's assume that an investor would have invested Rs.10,000 in the stock three years ago. As per BSE data, Cupid stock has delivered 6,775.62% return in three years. Which means that invested amount would have turned into Rs.6,88,500 in the duration, which is roughly equivalent to Rs.6.9 lakh.

Cupid stock closed 0.29% lower at Rs.279.15 per share on BSE with a market capitalisation of Rs.37,536.20 crore on Thursday. THe stock touched its 52-week high of Rs.298.95 per share on August 14, 2026.

Its return on equity (ROE) stood at 42.85%. The company scrip has delivered close to 68% return in three months, 252% return in six months and around 165% return year to date (YTD). The stock has rallied nearly 569.42 % in one year, 6,775% in three years and a whopping 11,984% in five years.

Cupid's net profit increased to Rs.44.16 crore in the June quarter of financial year 2026-27 against Rs.36 crore profit in the March quarter of FY26. The company had reported a net revenue of Rs.154.72 crore in Q1FY27 against Rs.119.96 crore in the March quarter. Its earnings per share (EPS) stood at Rs.0.33 in Q1FY27 and to Rs.0.27 in Q4FY26.
